parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic, representing the Earth's surface with printed maps. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It displays geographical information such as continents, countries, and oceans. It can rotate around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around a tilted axis supported by the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of durable plastic, typically circular and about 15 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the rotating sphere, keeping the globe upright and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the sphere rotates above it.
